purpose: library: hash tables — keys mapped to array positions by hash functions, collisions and the three families of collision resolution (open addressing, chaining, a special overflow area), perfect hashing, bucket arrays and overflow, constant Θ(1) complexity when the table is big enough or grows, clustering, and the 1953 Luhn/IBM historical note. Fits a compare table of collision-resolution schemes, a concept map of hashing terms, and quiz cards.
